rows.ARS:
Light pink Floribunda.
Registration name: Flamenco (floribunda, McGredy, 1955)
Exhibition name: Flamenco
rows.Origin: Bred by Samuel Darragh (1932-2019) McGredy IV (1955).
rows.Bloom: Light pink. Coral Pink. Deep salmon. Mild fragrance. 21 to 30 petals. Average diameter 3.5". Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy. Dark green foliage.

Height: up to 38" (up to 95cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Rain tolerant. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant.

colour: Light pink. Coral Pink. Deep salmon.
